subject.title: All .large bubbles should have scrollable body regardless of truncation

question: After the reader-managed transcript scrolling work, should large native message bodies gain nested bounded scrolling, or should tall content open through a separate full-message reader?
rationale: Both choices are implementable but define different gesture, accessibility, streaming, and cross-platform UX contracts that cannot be selected from static source evidence alone.

options.title: Use Explicit Reader
options.body: Keep transcript scrolling reader-managed and provide a bounded full-message reader for tall content, avoiding nested-scroll gesture competition.

options.title: Scroll Large Bodies
options.body: Give every large bubble a bounded inner scroller and require matching device proof for gestures, accessibility, and streaming on iOS and Android.

recommendation.title: Use Explicit Reader
recommendation.body: Keep transcript scrolling reader-managed and provide a bounded full-message reader for tall content, avoiding nested-scroll gesture competition.

likelyOwner.reason: This account previously reviewed the issue and is the strongest available owner for choosing the intended native interaction.
